verdict.rationale: Kick ships autonomous AI automation (auto-categorization, rule-based automation, 'self-driving' books) and exposes an MCP/CLI interface so external assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) can query and update data with approval, but the docs describe connecting third-party AI clients rather than a first-party in-app chat assistant UI for delegating tasks. missing for 10: evidence of a native in-product chat/assistant interface (not just MCP connector to external LLMs), and independent/hands-on confirmation of task delegation working end-to-end.
